prayerExcerpt.en-US: According to the ancient Martyrologies, St. Margaret suffered at Antioch in Pisidia, in the last general persecution.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Segundo os antigos Martirológios, Santa Margarida sofreu em Antioquia da Pisídia, na última perseguição geral.

meta.face: A Greek girl of Asia Minor of about sixteen, with a warm, light olive complexion and a SHORT, SQUARE face — a broad, STRAIGHT jaw ending in a small SQUARE chin, WIDE, FLAT cheekbones, a SHORT, straight nose with a broad bridge, very LARGE, WIDE-SET dark eyes under STRONG, straight, nearly level dark brows, a WIDE mouth with a full lower lip; black hair in two thick braids; the gaze direct and steady.
meta.basis: No likeness survives, and the book gives almost nothing: a martyr of Antioch in Pisidia, taught by a Christian nurse, persecuted by her pagan father. The Western image of her rising from a dragon is the part even the Golden Legend called fable, so the card shows the shepherdess of her Life with a cross and palm. The square face keeps her apart from the oval virgin martyrs.
